summary: Flesh and Bone is a 1993 neo noir drama written and directed by Steve Kloves, starring Meg Ryan, Dennis Quaid and James Caan. The note highlights Gwyneth Paltrow's early role, praised by Janet Maslin of The New York Times as a scene-stealer. The note is brief and gives only cast, director and a critical remark.
